verdict.rationale: Undermind documents an autonomous deep literature review that plans its own searches and runs until new searches stop finding relevant papers. Community reports confirm these are multi-minute jobs. Its documented notifications, however, are recurring alerts about newly published papers on saved topics, not a notice that a specific job has finished, so they do not cover the 'notify me when ready' half of the story. missing for 10: documented completion notification for a running job, evidence that jobs continue in the background after the user leaves (true unattended execution), any delivery channel for result-ready alerts.

support.subject: As an analyst, I can start a long research job that keeps working unattended and notifies me when the result is ready

citations.quote: Plans its own searches, follows citations and key authors, and stops only when new searches stop finding relevant papers.
